'''Monkey bread''' is a type of sweet pull-apart bread, typically flavored with cinnamon sugar.

== Ingredients ==

=== Bread ===
* 4 cans of biscuit dough, each biscuit cut into quarters
* ¾ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] white granulated [[Cookbook:Sugar|sugar]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Cinnamon|cinnamon]]

=== Glaze ===
* ¾ cup [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]] or [[Cookbook:Margarine|margarine]]
* ¾ cup [[Cookbook:Brown Sugar|brown sugar]]
* ¼ cup [[Cookbook:Sugar|white granulated sugar]]
* 1½ tsp [[Cookbook:Cinnamon|cinnamon]]

== Procedure ==
# Combine cinnamon and sugar for rolling.
# Roll biscuit sections in sugar mixture, placing in greased [[Cookbook:Bundt Pan|bundt pan]] or high-sided [[Cookbook:Cake Pan|cake pan]]. Do not pack tightly.
# Bring glaze ingredients to a [[Cookbook:Boiling|boil]], then pour over the dough in the pan.
# [[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] at 350°F (175°C) for 40–50 minutes.
# Invert onto plate, and serve warm.
